audio.note: Music comes from a royalty-free library with attribution (e.g. Kevin MacLeod, CC BY). No generated music service is connected. Voice must sit clearly above the music in every speech window — a global loudness number alone does not prove it.

cloud.note: /tmp is a 512 MB tmpfs on this VM and HyperFrames refuses to render when it is nearly full. Every render must set TMPDIR and HYPERFRAMES_EXTRACT_CACHE_DIR inside the workspace (see rendering/render.sh).

costs.note: No paid service is connected. Any feature needing payment must be flagged to the owner BEFORE integration.

durationPolicy.note: CORRECTED 21 Nov 2026 (Test 001 diagnosis): the video duration is DERIVED from the narration, never the reverse. Workflow: (1) estimate narration duration from word count (words / 2.43 w/s) BEFORE generating the voice — the estimate is a WARNING only (22 Nov 2026: measured speech rate varies 2.07-3.32 wps, so a word count can never validate the duration); (2) generate the voice; (3) measure the real duration and the real end of speech (silencedetect); (4) video_duration = max(narration_duration + 0.3, last_speech_end + endMarginSeconds). The HARD validation is on the MEASURED video duration (30-45 s) — a script that speaks too short or too long is rewritten and rebuilt, never cut. Padding exists only to fill the end margin (<= ~1 s), never to reach a pre-set video length. v3.1b (22 Nov 2026): the audio is TRIMMED to the video duration (atrim) so |audio - video| <= 0.02 s — the old ±0.1 s container check is replaced by the blocking 0.02 s gate; never pad audio to match the video. 22 Nov 2026: normalize-loudness.py trims the audio itself (atrim after loudnorm+aresample) and verifies the gap — no manual trim step.
durationPolicy.rule: Never cut a sentence to fit a predefined video duration. Never truncate an audio file to match a template duration. If the script exceeds the target, rewrite it BEFORE generating the voice.

language.note: All videos are in English (voice, on-screen text, metadata). Conversation with the owner stays French or English.

music.license: CC BY 3.0 — attribution required in video description
music.note: Phase 2: royalty-free bed mixed under the narration. The bed ends at last_speech + 0.3 s (0.3 s fade-out) so the end margin stays true silence and the final-silence QC gate still works. Voice must sit >= 6 dB above the bed in every speech window — verified by quality-control/check-mix.py, never by a global loudness number. Volume lowered 0.08 -> 0.04 on 22 Nov 2026: at 0.08 the facts draft measured only 3.0 dB voice-above-music (gate requires >= 6 dB).
music.title: Basic Implosion

qualityControl.note: Phase 3 gates (22 Nov 2026, blocking, no manual override — quality-control/gate.py runs them all): final silence within [endMargin - 0.5 s, endMargin + 0.75 s]; no mid-narration silence > 1.0 s; audio sample rate exactly 48000 Hz; |audio duration - video duration| <= 0.02 s (audio trimmed to the video duration with atrim, never padded); loudness -14 ± 0.5 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP; narration checked by FUZZY comparison (proper-noun lexicon, Whisper small on the final MP4, last sentence complete); captions synced within 0.3 s (Whisper tiny timings); voice >= 6 dB above the music in every speech window; Top 5: displayed and spoken values must sum consistently with the announced total; low-confidence Whisper words (< 0.6) listed with timestamps for the owner's listening. A FAIL blocks delivery.

safeZone.note: HyperFrames safe zone for 1080x1920 (TikTok / Reels / Shorts). Key text stays inside it; only texture/decoration outside. Captions sit at the bottom of the band.

video.note: Production target 30–45 s. The duration of EACH video is derived from its narration (see durationPolicy) — the target is a script-writing guide, never a render constraint. Test videos may use a different target range.

voiceover.note: No paid TTS service. HeyGen TTS is NOT connected and must not be used without the owner's explicit approval and a funded API key.
